profile_text: With a focus on human health and social work activities, this organization has experienced a 33.3% growth since its baseline, driven by its commitment to providing essential services to the community. As a key player in the sector, it operates from its base in Düsseldorf-Eller, offering support and resources from its headquarters at Hohenfriedbergstr. 32. With 100 employees in 2024, its expansion is a testament to the increasing demand for its specialized social work and health services.
